description:
Legacy compaction status rows render without blocking queued messages. The test seeded a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose server data reports one queued message, "queued during compaction", and also an in-progress compaction status row that the old generation-based compaction left behind. The live event stream is cut off.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible.
2. [data-testid="distill-in-progress"] should contain "Compacting", and [data-testid="queued-badge"] should be visible.
3. Click the [data-testid="queued-badge"]: [data-testid="send-queued-now"] and [data-testid="cancel-queued"] should become visible (up to 5s).
